items.title: Artemis III NASA announcement highlights: Luca Parmitano assigned as pilot
items.summary: Video: 00:07:18 On 9 June, NASA announced the crew for the Artemis III mission, which includes ESA astronaut Luca Parmitano as pilot. ESA is also providing its third European Service Module for this crewed test flight in Earth orbit, which will be key for the mission’s objective
